bias_targets.methodology: Measured using the proposed DivDist framework across various settings: text co-occurrence and human annotations, cosine similarity of average group vectors in static word embeddings, and linear probing in contextualized representations (BERT, GPT-2). Evaluations included comparing these metrics against US Census labor statistics and testing language models for bias amplification.

Quantified in word embeddings by calculating the cosine similarity between average target embeddings and group embeddings (using White, Hispanic, and Asian word lists). The measurements were correlated with historical and contemporary US Census employment statistics to test for predictive validity.

Evaluated in static word embeddings specifically to test 'hypothesis validity' by analyzing whether previously proposed debiasing algorithms effectively reduce religious bias associations when measured using the DivDist framework.
